fields.Name: IT186 - Comms V2 Activity Worker and GDPR Erasure
fields.Description: Exercises CommsActivityWorker event processing, deduplication, SoftBounceThresholdPolicy auto-suppression, and EraseEndpointPII against live SQL Server.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Hard bounce and soft bounce thresholds create suppressions, duplicate events are skipped, and EraseEndpointPII scrubs PII while preserving compliance records.
